title: After 0 of 3: start from the beginning
source: Percent Session, after the first Check 1 attempt scored 0 of 3 (TUTOR_SPEC section 7, T2)
message: i dont know any of this stuff. start from the beginning and explain it to a complete beginner
graderChecks: Does it teach the first idea only (points: the new rate minus the old rate), leaving basis points and percent change for later?
Does it give exactly one worked example?
Does it use no second analogy?
notes: Pass when: teaches the first idea only (points). One worked example. One ask. No second analogy.
